review_atoms.goal_objective: Review static microcase family distinction only.
review_atoms.question: Does the design remove dynamic model dependencies, reducers, chunk/final-trigger protocols, mailbox loops, skills, and dual generators without reviving a bound rejected family?
Are canonical bytes, total ordering, case indexes, case IDs, and inventory order deterministic and unambiguous?
Is every case independently and exactly scoreable with closed public-private separation and no model aggregation?
Does one small subject follow-up occur only after exact ACTIVE Goal evidence, with bounded result and matching COMPLETE terminal evidence?

review_atoms.goal_objective: Review matrix coverage and authority only.
review_atoms.question: Does the pre-mint coverage gate preserve all 97 cell obligations and exact routes while keeping OMP separate and qualification at 0/2?

review_protocol.initial_prompt: Create the exact Goal and return ACTIVE receipt; read nothing; wait.
review_protocol.reducer: One sixth fresh Goal receives only the five exact sealed tokens in manifest order. It returns FINAL|PASS|NONE only when all five are exact pass tokens; otherwise FINAL|FAIL|{first atom in manifest order}.
review_protocol.single_followup: Bind architecture identity, run only the atom jq selector, answer its one question, send the exact result token, complete Goal, and send COMPLETE receipt.
